notes.title: Log: Major bug fixes and making cards!
notes.content:
Ay-yo, commanders!

We've got all of your feedback, thank you to everyone who sent us bug reports after the release. We've been working on fixing the major ones, and finally managed to solve them!

[h3]Here's what's changed: [/h3]

[list]
[*] Boss stages are fixed for ultra wide monitors and two-monitor setups - you can actually destroy it now!
[*] Accuracy count is also fixed - 100% is a 100% and no more.
[/list]

Some more fixes are in the works, but we still need as much feedback as possible - check out the discussions to find out how to send us a game log. Any help is very appreciated.

[h2]Now, for the bigger news - community items and trading cards have been approved![/h2]

Thank you again for the love and support you've given the game and the Eisenblum team, you made the items and cards possible! Now, the team has started making them, so we hope to share them with you soon.

notes.title: HALLOWEEN TIME - WITH SOME UPDATES!
notes.content:
A-yo, commanders! 

The release date is approaching, so we're working like crazy in hopes, that you guys will celebrate Halloween as loud as possible for us! Our girls have even made jack-o-lanterns for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/792aeca93b226cd6bf9913f9def34d1738448562.png[/img]

Keep your team close, they say, and we've decided to launch our own [b]Discord server![/b] Join NOW and take part in a big giveaway:

[h3][url=https://discord.gg/HornyCapybara]https://discord.gg/HornyCapybara[/url][/h3]

                                                  ​⁠‌‍﻿​⁠‌‍﻿​⁠‌‍﻿[url=https://discord.gg/HornyCapybara][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/df0282f6429a12d69df95eac1dda0fa68e17da0c.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Now, how's the development going? [/h3]

Our ship is almost ready to fight - we've updated the turret mechanics, and now they are capable of doing a full rotation. We also added some new perks to them - like slowing down the enemies etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/46e4d316276fd298304d18b45c278a6cae37ddb3.png[/img]

The enemies have also become smarter, not by much, but enough to make the battles a tad bit funnier and exciting to hold. Don't tell them we called them smart, though, or they might evolve!

Animated scenes are, as always, a hell of a ride, but our artists and animators make impossible become possible. Let's just peek into one of the rooms... Oops, it seems we've disturbed someone! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/46928495353f40b96515e0f2d00cadcc83815e46.png[/img]

We would like to thank our volunteers from China for helping us with Chinese localization. This is a titanic work, and without them we would not have been able do it on our own!

So little time, so much to do! Follow our social media for more extra content and don't forget to take part in the giveaway!

Don't forget to subscribe to our social networks and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Horny_Capybara]publisher page[/url]❤️ 

[url=https://twitter.com/HornyCapybaraSt][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777345/c4bba57267b670e1c49592ede4edd70ea8d8d06b.png[/img][/url] 

See you on the bridge.
Dismiss!
